name: Events Showcase and Filter Bar for The Events Calendar – Eventful
author: ThemeAtelier

sections.description:
👁️Live Demo | 📖Documentation | 🚀Upgrade to Pro! | 👩🏼‍💻Support | 🌟Rate This Plugin

Eventful is an addon for The Events Calendar that lets you showcase your events in modern, responsive layouts.
Choose from sliders, carousels, grids, or lists, and customize the design to fit your website — no coding required.

With support for popular page builders like Elementor and Gutenberg, Eventful makes it easy to highlight upcoming events, workshops, conferences, or community activities in a way that feels professional and engaging.

Key Highlights:
– Works with the free version of The Events Calendar
– Mobile-friendly layouts that adapt to any device
– Easy to configure with an intuitive settings panel
– Shortcode and block support for flexible placement

Key Features

  • Multiple Layouts : Create sliders and grids across your website
  • Responsive columns : customize how many events appear on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Equalize box height for uniform display
  • Set custom margins between events
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design

  • Works seamlessly with any theme and The Events Calendar plugin

  • Display by :

    • Latest, Featured or Specific Event
    • Exclude Specific Event
    • Category or Tag
    • Keyword
  • Filter by Categories, Tags.
  • Sort by: Title, Event Start Date, ID, Slug, Random
  • Ascending / Descending order option
  • Advanced Shortcode Generator with 300+ visual customization options
  • Effortless shortcode copy-paste for posts, pages, and builders
  • Show / Hide elements:
    • Title, image, description, excerpt
    • Venue, organizer, time, date, category
    • Read More button, meta fields, social sharing
  • Drag-and-drop content order: image, title, meta, buttons, etc.
  • 5 meta separator styles
  • Display full content, excerpt with limit, or short content
  • Read More button: custom text, style, and color
  • Content alignment: Left, Center, Right
  • Full typography control: 840+ Google Fonts, font size, spacing, color, and weight
  • Unlimited color customization for all elements
  • Image control:
    • Set dimensions (width/height)
    • Hard crop and adaptive height
    • Retina-ready support
  • 30+ slider/carousel settings including:
    • Speed control
    • Autoplay on/off
    • Stop on hover
    • Loop mode (endless)
    • Multiple items to scroll
    • Touch swipe and mouse drag control
  • 1 arrow style and 3 position options
  • Pagination color, speed, and style options
  • Events Schema SEO Support
  • Page Builder support: Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, Brizy, and others
  • Multilingual ready: WPML, Polylang
  • RTL support
  • Multisite compatible
  • Accessibility-ready
  • SEO optimized and speed-friendly
  • Supports all major browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge
  • Clean and intuitive admin panel
  • No coding required — easy for non-tech users
  • Extensive documentation and step-by-step video tutorials
  • Friendly and fast developer support

Why Choose Eventful?

Unlike basic event shortcode plugins, Eventful gives you complete design control with rich layout styles, advanced filters, flexible display options, and full builder compatibility—so you can create event showcases that match your brand and boost engagement.

Whether you’re running a nonprofit, school, church, conference, or local community calendar—Eventful helps you present your events in a way that looks professional, feels intuitive, and helps your visitors take action.

  • Events Ticker
  • Multi-row Carousel
  • Events Grid
  • Events Masonry
  • Events List

  • Events Content Positions

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate The Events Calendar
  2. Upload the eventful plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via Plugins > Add New
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Go to Eventful > Add New Layout to create your first event showcase
  5. Use the generated shortcode or Gutenberg block to display it on your site
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without The Events Calendar?

No. Eventful is an addon that requires the free The Events Calendar plugin to function.

Can I use this inside Elementor or Gutenberg editor?

Yes! Eventful works seamlessly with Elementor and Gutenberg. Use the shortcode or block to embed your layout anywhere.

Is it mobile responsive?

Absolutely. All Eventful layouts are 100% responsive and mobile-friendly.

Can I choose which events to show?

Yes. Filter events by category, tag, date, venue, organizer, and more.

Do you offer a Pro version?

Yes. Eventful Pro unlocks advanced layouts, design templates, extended filtering, and premium support. Compare Free vs Pro →

How can I obtain support?

Submit your query in plugin Support Forum

I have some suggestions for improving this plugin. How can I communicate with you?

You can create a topic in our Support Forum or send me a direct mail at themeatelierbd@gmail.com
